notes.title: v0.17.1 - Rocket Launcher changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I've fixed some bugs and improved the rocket launcher!

Rocket launcher changes:


Explosion radius - 9m > 5.7m
Added sounds for the rocket travelling
Added new achievement - To the Moon!
Fixed rocket not disappearing after exploding


Enjoy the update! ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: v0.16.3 - KOTH changes
notes.notes:
• The King of The Hill zone shader has been revamped and is also visible from both sides.
• Shooting at the king of the hill zone has some visual effects and sounds now
• Seconds per point in KOTH zone 0.5s > 0.8s
• Ocean and Mansion can no longer be played in KOTH gamemode
• Weapon clipping has been fixed

notes.title: Bug fixes and new achievement
notes.notes: Fixed all the bugs I found with the previous update and added a new achievement for getting 10 wins. Achievements no longer get reset when launching the game

notes.title: Huge UI changes
notes.notes: The main menu and pause menu have been revamped, some balancing changes have been done, 1 new ability and 1 new specialty have been added.

notes.title: Achievement Update
notes.notes: 3 new achievements have been added, also sniper damage has been nerfed from 77 to 70, so you need 3 compressed ammos to make it do 100 damage.

notes.title: Small character customization update
notes.notes: You can now see your character when in the character customizer ːsteamhappyː

notes.notes:
Better regeneration - faster regeneration, but you don't regenerate health if less than 10 seconds have passed since the last time you took damage.

Health no longer goes below 0

Ranged rifle nerf (40 damage - 35 damage)

Shotgun - less spread (i have no idea how my spread function works so i cant say how much it changed cuz im stupid)

Better settings menu

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Added a low pass filter and post-processing effects when low health.

Weapon changes

Shotgun changes (12 damage per pellet - 13 damage per pellet),

Ranged rifle changes (reload speed 2.5s - 3.5s, max ammo 10 - 6),

Charge revolver changes (charge speed 2.5 charge per second - 1.25 charge per second, 2s reload speed - 3.3s reload speed)
